Name: Vault-Tec home tiles
Author: StaticOpium
Description:
This tile b[b]esed [/b]on textures from Fallout 1 and 2.  Clean, new stuff straight out of the Vault.
 
Adds:
1. A metal [i][b]cage[/b][/i] for little mutants!...umm...I mean your offsprings, yes.
2. One nice big bed.
3. New kitchen with refrigerator from 40's.
2. Some metal wall decor instead of old wood.

[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]
1. Make a backup of your original file named "farmouse_tiles.xnb" (Stardew Valley\Content folder) .
If you're using Steam, the default folder path is something like C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\
2. Now replace/overwrite it by this new file.

You may took parts from here to your mods if you like. Just make some credit/link to my page.

Downloads.Description: Unzip and replace farm house tiles.
